specs.title: [NEO-023-A] six seeded art styles render deterministically with accessible real cover title and author
[NEO-024-A] visible cover refresh and context-menu New cover persist fresh seed and artwork
[NEO-025-A] cover picker copies selected image, cancel retains it and reload shows it
[NEO-026-A] real disk-backed File dropped on cover is copied through original Electron path bridge
[NEO-027-A] remove custom cover removes its file and renders seeded fallback

[NEO-030-A] opening imported long story does not paint until eligible explicit refresh request

[NEO-032-A] fake provider key stays outside library and is removed through cover settings
[NEO-034-A] custom image remains preferred over completed painting on reopening
[NEO-035-A] binding shelf adds cover and page affordances without replacing constituent books
[NEO-036-A] unbinding parks page files and rebind restores them before original stories

[NEO-039-A] all back ghost pages insert after constituent stories in canonical order
